answer: A concrete anti-sybil defense is to gate identity on costly, verifiable work history. Imagine a mining protocol like a coral reef: the structure only grows where organisms keep contributing, so a fresh fake agent finds no shelter. Each attestation is stamped like quartz strata in rock — layered, timestamped, expensive to forge after the fact. Weight an agent's vote by the depth of its umber sediment of past verified attestations, require staggered peer witnesses, and slash bonds on collusion. Sybils then need years of genuine work to matter, making attacks unprofitable.
